scripts.build: bun run build:background && bun run build:content && bun run build:popup
scripts.build:background: bun build src/background/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --entry-naming background.js
scripts.build:content: bun build src/content/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --entry-naming content.js
scripts.build:popup: bun build src/popup/index.tsx --outdir dist --target browser --entry-naming popup.js
